properties.name: rmcp 3.5.0 → 3.6.0 (declared "3.6"); stdio sessions and the --call door's pipe take no line bound, as before
properties.rationale:
Closes the gap fact:mcp-sdk-currency-checked-across-the-hubs-servers-2026-10-22 recorded in hub 662c0b99b5d5a913 under rule:every-mcp-server-carries-the-three-standard-requirements, and req:reflow2-keeps-its-dependencies-at-or-near-their-latest-releases. Anthony's word 2026-10-22: queue the rmcp 3.6.0 PR first after P7 part 4.

WHAT EACH 3.6.0 CHANGE MEANS FOR reflow2, measured:
- #1326 rejects SERVER-to-client requests (sampling, roots, elicitation) when the peer negotiated 2026-07-28 or later. reflow2 sends none (it only notifies tools/list_changed, which is not a request), so nothing it does is rejected. 2026-07-28 clients are served (Claude Code 2.1.283 opens on it over stdio); flo2's gateway and the copy tool negotiate 2025-06-18.
- #1377: only a POST with NO session that is not initialize changes, 422 → 400. flo2's gateway (reflow2-client.ts at flo2 origin/main 9404622) always initializes session-less, then sends everything on the minted session, and already treats 400 and 404 as a forgotten session to re-handshake once. Its exact sequence, replayed on the 3.6.0 binary: initialize 200 with a session, initialized 202, tools/call 200. No flo2 change is needed.
- #1322 (3.5.1): stateless 2026-07-28 invalid-params → HTTP 200 in-band, was 400 (set_capability_status on a missing capability). Legacy sessions were never mapped. No reflow2 test pinned the 400.
- #1049: the bound is 16 MiB per line (DEFAULT_MAX_LINE_LENGTH), discard-and-continue with no reply. Measured: a 17 MiB stdio request was answered on 3.5.0 and dropped on 3.6.0; --call export_graph on reflow2's own design (36,932,383 bytes) hung until killed. Lifted on the --call pipe first (test a_call_longer_than_rmcps_line_bound_is_answered_both_ways: fails without the fix at 120 s, passes with it), then, on Anthony's word 2026-10-22 ("lift rmcp's new 16 MiB limit on ordinary MCP connections, so they behave as before"), on every stdio session too (tests a_stdio_session_answers_a_message_of_any_length: both fail without the fix at 120 s with only the ping answered, both pass with it in 5.9 s). Whether a connection should bound a message and ANSWER when it is exceeded is the open dec:idea-an-mcp-connection-bounds-a-message-and-answers-with-an-error-when-it-is-exceeded, not built here.
- #1349 looks tool schemas up per request, only for 2026-07-28 tools/call header validation; reflow2's get_tool is the macro's router lookup, so the cost is negligible and a per-request view can no longer read a stale cached schema.
- #1283, #1329, #1308: no reflow2 test changed shape; reflow2 builds with both client and server features; reflow2 already writes its own ttlMs/cacheScope.
- Not adopted now: stdio_pipes (#1304) changes every stdio session's I/O for an unmeasured gain; the client cancel of abandoned calls (#1344) touches only the door's in-process client, which never abandons a call.

This PR's copy also carries live writes made outside it, adopted on the coordinating session's word (Anthony, 2026-10-22): req:a-superseded-mirrored-judgment-is-kept-and-what-rested-on-it-reads-reason-lost with its EVOLVES_INTO edge; fact:the-navier-stokes-map-rung-ran-on-0-90-0-and-a-claim-reads-as-a-claim-but-reflow2-has-no-claimed-reading-2026-10-22 with its HAS_TEMPORAL_FACT edge; and the proposed dec:idea-an-mcp-connection-bounds-a-message-and-answers-with-an-error-when-it-is-exceeded. None of them is built here.

Verified: cargo dev-test 3,449 passed 0 failed (first commit); the door and stdio tests with RocksDB; clippy -D warnings with and without default features; fmt; toolsnap (200 match); test_call_door; smoke_mcp; stateless_seat_probe; test_shared_sessions; test_degraded_server; refusal_speaks; empty_speaks; a_reply_is_sent_once; every_tool_carries_a_title.

properties.summary: reflow2 is built on rmcp 3.6.0, the Rust MCP SDK's latest release (was 3.5.0; 3.5.1 came between). Tool surface unchanged: 200 toolsnaps match. On the wire, measured on the built binary before and after: a session-less non-initialize POST in legacy mode is answered 400 'Session ID is required' (was 422); on 2026-07-28 stateless HTTP a tool's invalid-params refusal comes back HTTP 200 with the JSON-RPC error in-band (was HTTP 400), and a JSON-RPC response posted by the client is refused with 400 (was 202, ignored). rmcp 3.6.0's new 16 MiB bound on an incoming line is lifted everywhere reflow2 serves over a line transport: every stdio serve path builds its transport through main.rs stdio_unbounded, the shared proxy's in-process degraded surface and the --call door's in-process pipe set with_max_line_length(usize::MAX), so a message of any length is answered as on 3.5.0. HTTP's 4 MiB request cap (answered 413) is unchanged. handshake.rs's copy of rmcp's negotiation rule is unchanged in 3.6.0 (its line reference is updated).
